name: wallgraph
description: A free, browser-based floorplan editor. mm-exact, wall-graph based, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: tsx tests/core.test.ts && tsx tests/i18n.test.ts && tsx tests/dxf.test.ts && tsx tests/svg.test.ts
scripts.assets: rsvg-convert -w 1200 -h 630 assets/og.svg -o assets/og.png && magick assets/og.png -strip -colors 64 PNG8:assets/og.png && magick assets/icon.png -resize 32x32 -strip assets/favicon-32.png && magick assets/icon.png -resize 180x180 -background none -strip assets/apple-touch-icon.png && magick assets/icon.png -define icon:auto-resize=48,32,16 assets/favicon.ico
